title: Ashgrove Graduate Admissions, 2025-26 Cycle
description: One row per application to Ashgrove's graduate school for the 2025-26 cycle, with the final decision. The pooled figures are being quoted as proof of something. One thing about this file changes what they mean. Find it.

columns.age: int, applicant's age in years at submission
columns.residency: categorical, domestic or international fee status
columns.undergrad_gpa: float, undergraduate GPA on a 4.0 scale
columns.department: categorical, the department the applicant applied to
columns.admitted: int, 1 if offered a place, 0 if rejected
